{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values
df_info = penguins.isnull().sum()
print(df_info)

# Drop rows with missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Check the cleaned data
print(f"\nCleaned data shape: {penguins_clean.shape}")

# Compute Pearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g
pearson_corr = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Print the result
pearson_corr"}
